# Open Learning Hub

> Original, local-first course pilots and practice tools.

The development curriculum has 36 course pilots in six tracks: Workforce Management, Excel & Spreadsheets, Data & Analytics, Software Development, AI & Intelligent Systems, and Automation & Delivery.
Each pilot has three authored topic lessons, checkpoints, assignments and a capstone brief. These are not yet comprehensive beginner-to-advanced courses. No professional certificates or verified grades are issued.
Progress stays in the current browser and can be exported. The static app has no mandatory accounts, keys or server execution.
Historical WFM, Python and glossary material remains at its original HTML routes. Hash routes provide application navigation.
